text: I'm currently doing a part-time job at a language centre while finishing my degree. What I like most is that every day is a bit different, so I never get bored.

tips.en: One specific detail makes the answer memorable.
tips.kk: Бір нақты деталь жауапты есте қаларлық етеді.
tips.ru: Одна конкретная деталь делает ответ запоминающимся.
tips.example: every day is a bit different

tips.en: A complex structure raises Grammatical Range.
tips.example: What I like most is that

questions.followUp: What do you like most about it?
questions.question: Let's talk about work. Do you work or study?

text: Ideally, I'd like to work in international business, because it combines my interest in languages with a chance to travel. I'd also want a role with real responsibility rather than just routine tasks.

tips.en: A complex structure raises Grammatical Range.
tips.example: I'd like to work in international business, because it combines my interest in languages with a chance to travel

questions.question: What kind of job would you like to have in the future?

text: It depends on the task, but I generally prefer teamwork. Bouncing ideas off other people helps me see things from different angles, though I do like quiet time to focus on the details by myself.

tips.en: Precise topic vocabulary lifts the Lexical Resource score.

tips.en: Hedging sounds natural and avoids being absolute.
tips.kk: Сақ тұжырым табиғи естіледі және қатаңдықтан аулақ.
tips.ru: Осторожная формулировка звучит естественно и избегает категоричности.

questions.question: Do you prefer working alone or in a team?

text: For me, it's job satisfaction. A good salary matters, of course, but I'd rather do something meaningful than something that pays well and makes me miserable every Monday morning.

tips.en: Contrast deepens the answer and shows balance.
tips.ru: Противопоставление делает ответ глубже и показывает баланс.
tips.example: A good salary matters, of course, but I'd rather do something meaningful

tips.en: Contractions and spoken words make speech sound natural.
